digest.component_or_area: inbound link removal path (reconciler G5, apply_inbound_records.py)
propositions: managed_refs marks a reference managed at local creation but cannot distinguish never-pushed links from peer-deleted ones
outbound_links dedup ADDs direction-agnostically on (vendor_type, target_key) not on relation, so colliding direction-opposite links are never pushed and unprotected by G4
a never-peer-confirmed link can reach the inbound removal applier and be deleted when an inbound removal record arrives
removal records must be declined and logged for links lacking positive peer confirmation, and honored only for links a snapshot has proven the peer carries

peer confirmation persists durable association (Jira linkId, origin, snapshot pass_id, confirmed_at time) in a sidecar store, survives snapshot compaction, and backfills existing managed links at upgrade
